chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad narrated what we mentioned, from Muḥammad ibn Sahl, from his father, who said:

I asked Abā al-Ḥasan عليه السلام about a man who leaves the ghusl (ritual bath) of Friday, forgetfully or otherwise. He said: If he was forgetful, then his salat (prayer) is complete. But if he did so deliberately, then the ghusl is more beloved to me; so if he has done that, then let him seek forgiveness from Allah and not return to it.

key_terms.الْغُسْلَ: the ritual bath, here referring to the Friday ghusl
key_terms.صَلَاتُهُ: his salat (prayer), whose validity is being discussed
key_terms.فَلْيَسْتَغْفِرِ اللَّهَ: let him seek forgiveness from Allah for the deliberate omission
key_terms.يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ: Friday, the day on which this recommended ghusl is observed

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if someone deliberately or forgetfully leaves the Friday ghusl?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses the ruling on omitting the Friday ghusl. It distinguishes between forgetting and deliberate omission: the prayer remains valid in the case of forgetfulness, while deliberate abandonment is blameworthy and requires seeking forgiveness, showing the emphasized status of this recommended ghusl.
